candidates.why_relevant: HN is the Czech reference business daily (publisher Economia, a.s.). Its Byznys desk is normally first to interpret quarterly results of ČSOB, Komerční banka, Česká spořitelna, Moneta, Raiffeisenbank, Air Bank/Partners and to obtain executive comment and unpublished deal detail that never reaches a formal disclosure. Verified on fetch that corporate earnings items (e.g. Deutsche Telekom results, DAX 40 results, KKCG transactions) run in this section, confirming an earnings/deal beat.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; free headline/teaser layer, HN+ premium articles behind subscription (predplatne.hn.cz)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of section listing + HN RSS; store headline, deck, timestamp, author, URL. For HN+ bodies use a paid subscription seat or a licensed archive (Anopress/Newton/Monitora) rather than scraping past the paywall.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of publisher navigation + snowball from hn.cz homepage

candidates.why_relevant: Date-indexed archive of the HN print edition with search and purchasable PDF issues (observed price 40 Kč per issue). This is the retrospective entry point for reconstructing how a bank's results or a payments deal was reported at the time, including print-only analysis and charts that never appeared online.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; per-issue purchase or subscription; redistribution not permitted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/targeted retrieval by date around known results dates; buy the specific PDF issue. Do not bulk-harvest.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from HN homepage navigation (Archiv link)

candidates.why_relevant: Weekly business magazine from Economia (published since 1996), sister title of HN. Runs the longer-form 'why' behind a results season — sector profitability, branch/fee strategy, digital and payments strategy interviews with bank CEOs. Confirmed on fetch that Finance/Investment is a standing coverage area and that an issue archive exists at /vydani.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; hard subscription — fetch returned 'Pro tento web nemáte aktivní předplatné'
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe (or bundle with HN) and collect the weekly issue table of contents + the Wednesday newsletter; index headlines even when bodies are unavailable, then pull full text via subscription seat.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch
candidates.observed_blocker: Subscription wall message 'Pro tento web nemáte aktivní předplatné' shown instead of article bodies

candidates.why_relevant: E15 (publisher CZECH NEWS CENTER a.s., IČO 02346826) maintains an explicit, dedicated banking beat — verified on fetch: the section carries bank profits, interest rates, ČNB decisions, bank bond issues (e.g. Trinity Bank emissions), crypto adoption by banks and mortgage/fee topics. This is the single most on-target mainstream section in this cell for CZ bank earnings and payments news.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; freemium with 'e15 Premium' tier; listing pages and many articles openly readable
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the section listing 2-3x daily plus the site RSS at https://www.e15.cz/rss; capture headline/lede/author/timestamp; premium bodies via subscription seat.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the section, then snowball to publisher/RSS from e15.cz homepage

candidates.why_relevant: Long-standing Czech business brand (originally the Euro weekly), now run online by the Internet Info / iinfo.cz group. Carries Byznys and Ekonomika desks, currency rates and investment/personal-finance coverage; useful as a second-opinion commentary channel on bank results and on unlisted banks. Note the editorial mix has drifted toward lifestyle/consumer topics, so precision is lower than HN/E15.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; no paywall observed; newsletter registration optional
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of /clanky listings filtered on banking/payments keywords; no RSS link was visible on the homepage, so use listing-page crawling.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Seznam Zprávy (Seznam.cz) is the highest-reach Czech-owned digital newsroom with a well-resourced investigative/business desk. It breaks ownership, governance and deal stories about banks and payment firms that listed disclosures omit, and it covers unlisted institutions. Section tree verified on fetch (Byznys 194 with Finance 299, Firmy 297, Reality 298, Právo 308 subsections).
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; no general paywall observed (only a 'Zdraví+' vertical subscription promoted)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl section listing pages (numeric section IDs are stable) several times daily; article URLs end in a numeric ID usable as a dedupe key.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first guessed section ID returned the wrong desk (Svět); corrected by fetching the homepage navigation and snowballing the real section IDs

candidates.why_relevant: The finance sub-desk of Seznam Zprávy, self-described as 'Investování, burzy a trhy, daně a důchody'. Verified on fetch that it carries corporate/bank result items (e.g. a piece on the world's oldest bank defending itself against a takeover, Lego profit) alongside pensions, markets and crypto — a clean single URL to watch for results-season interpretation.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; open access observed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Listing crawl alongside section 194; dedupe by article numeric ID.
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Seznam Zprávy homepage navigation, then direct fetch of the subsection

candidates.why_relevant: Economia's free-to-read news portal, editorially adjacent to HN, so HN/Economia reporting on banks often surfaces here without a paywall. Verified on fetch: section carries Czech-economy, pensions/savings and insurance items and exposes an RSS export at /export-rss with no paywall — the cheapest reliable machine-readable mainstream feed in this cell.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; open access, RSS offered by the publisher for syndication
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Subscribe to the site RSS export and poll the /ekonomika/ and /ekonomika/ceska-ekonomika/ listings hourly.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of the section listing

candidates.why_relevant: MAFRA's mass-reach daily portal; its Ekonomika desk is a high-volume amplifier of bank results releases and consumer-facing payments/fee changes, and reaches audiences (and sources) the specialist finance press does not. Named explicitly in the cell definition, so it must be tracked even though I could not verify it in this run.
candidates.access_status: unverified — assumed freemium (MAFRA operates a 'Premium' tier)
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; assumed freemium, unverified this run
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Listing crawl of ekonomika.idnes.cz plus the site's servis/rss feeds; verify feed paths in a browser-based pass since the fetch tool is blocked for this host.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cell definition; attempted direct fetch
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch returned 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from ekonomika.idnes.cz' — a client-side block, NOT evidence the site is down; treat as live-but-unverified

candidates.why_relevant: MAFRA's quality daily (Lidové noviny lineage); carries commentary and analysis on bank results and financial-sector policy for a business-leaning readership, and shares MAFRA newsroom output with iDNES. Named in the cell definition; could not be verified this run.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; assumed freemium, unverified this run
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Listing crawl plus RSS once feed paths are confirmed in a browser-based pass.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cell definition; attempted direct fetch
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch returned 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from www.lidovky.cz' — client-side block, not a liveness verdict

candidates.why_relevant: The largest-reach Czech news portal (Borgis a.s. / Seznam.cz, carrying Právo newsroom content). Verified on fetch that the economy section runs corporate and consumer-payments stories (e.g. a cash-on-delivery payment dispute at a parcel box). Value here is reach and consumer-payments signal rather than analytical depth — it shows which bank/payments topics become mass-market issues.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; open access observed
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Section listing crawl; confirm the RSS path in a browser pass (no RSS link exposed in the fetched markup).
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Public-service broadcaster newsroom; verified on fetch that the economics desk (rubrika ekonomika-17) covers budgets, pensions, wages and carries video/commentary formats ('Události, komentáře z ekonomiky', 'Bilance ČT') in which bank executives and analysts appear on the record. Broadcast interviews are a distinctive channel for executive comment that no written disclosure contains, and ČT offers RSS.
candidates.legal_status: public broadcaster; content copyrighted, RSS offered; video reuse restricted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: RSS + section crawl for text; for video/debate formats capture programme metadata and, where needed, transcripts via the broadcaster's own text summaries rather than re-hosting media.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Public-facing news site of ČTK, the Czech news agency. ČTK is the wire that carries bank results the moment they are released and is the upstream text most Czech mainstream outlets rewrite — so it timestamps the news cycle and lets you distinguish agency copy from original reporting. Verified on fetch: economy section exists, RSS at /rss/, email news service, ISSN 1213-5003, explicit Terms of Use governing reuse.
candidates.access_status: open (public tier); full ČTK wire is a paid licence
candidates.legal_status: copyright ČTK; reuse governed by 'Podmínky užití' — index and quote briefly, do not republish; a commercial ČTK licence is required for redistribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll /rss/ and the ekonomika listing; store metadata + short excerpt only. For full-text rights, negotiate a ČTK licence.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: ČTK's paid press-release distribution wire, with a 'finance, ekonomika' category. Verified on fetch that Czech bank material runs here (a Komerční banka / KB+ release with client numbers was on the homepage). This is where banks push announcements they want amplified but that are not formal regulatory disclosures — a direct feed of primary corporate claims plus a pointer to which institutions are actively communicating.
candidates.access_status: open to read; paid to publish
candidates.legal_status: releases are publisher-supplied PR; ČTK terms apply; content is promotional and must be labelled as such
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl https://www.protext.cz/kategorie/finance-ekonomika/ daily; treat every item as an unverified corporate claim and tag source_type=press_release.
candidates.discovered_via_method: inferred from first principles (who benefits from publishing) then verified by direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Independent subscription daily (publisher N Media, a.s.) with a strong investigative record; its Ekonomika desk and 'byznys' / 'finance' tags carry ownership, governance and financial-crime angles on Czech banks and financial groups that other outlets underplay. Section tree verified on fetch after a first guessed path (/rubrika/byznys/) 404'd.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; subscription at predplatne.denikn.cz; free selected articles
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Index headlines from /ekonomika/ and tag pages (tag/byznys, tag/finance); use a paid seat for bodies.
candidates.discovered_via_method: failed guessed path, then snowball from denikn.cz homepage navigation

candidates.why_relevant: Fast-growing Czech business/tech outlet that is often first on fintech, payments and neobank product/deal news and on funding rounds of Czech payment companies. Verified on fetch that it runs bank-adjacent stories (e.g. the first Czech bank enabling direct bitcoin purchase in its app) and maintains /byznys/, /investice/, /krypto/, /e-commerce/, /startupy/ sections — a distinct signal channel from the legacy dailies.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; largely open
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /byznys/, /investice/, /krypto/, /e-commerce/ listings daily; keyword-filter on bank and payment-provider names.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles snowball (who covers unlisted/private payment firms) + direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Licensed Czech Forbes edition; runs profiles and interviews with owners and CEOs of Czech financial groups (including unlisted banks and investment houses) where deal rationale and figures are volunteered that appear in no filing. Homepage fetch returned only a tagline, so section structure is unverified — treat coverage claims as an unconfirmed hypothesis.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; licensed brand edition
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Re-map the section tree in a browser-based pass (the /rubrika/ path 301-redirected to a legacy CDN image), then crawl the business/finance listings.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch (partial)
queries_used: direct fetch: https://forbes.cz/rubrika/byznys/ (301 to cdn.forbes.cz image)
candidates.observed_blocker: Homepage rendered as a single tagline with no navigation; /rubrika/byznys/ 301-redirected to https://cdn.forbes.cz/uploads/2014/09/Byznys.jpg — a stale legacy rewrite, not proof the section is gone

candidates.why_relevant: Opinion-forward news site (publisher CMI News) with a standing EKONOMIKA desk and a large podcast slate; useful as a commentary/framing channel on banking taxation, windfall-tax debate and regulation. Verified on fetch that the section exists in navigation; note the masthead openly states a right-wing editorial perspective, so treat as commentary, not neutral reporting.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; freemium with registration/subscription tiers
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Locate the working Ekonomika section path in a browser pass (the guessed /ekonomika path 404'd), then low-frequency crawl; tag all items as opinion.
candidates.discovered_via_method: direct fetch of homepage after a 404 on the guessed section path

candidates.why_relevant: National site of the VLM regional daily network — the only mainstream channel with dense regional reach, which matters for branch closures, ATM withdrawal/cash-access stories and regional savings-bank/credit-union coverage that national desks skip. Fetch returned 403, so structure is unverified.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browser-based or user-agent-respecting crawler; low frequency, keyword-filtered on pobočka/bankomat/hotovost.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (regional layer of the media system) + attempted fetch
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 Forbidden on WebFetch — typical bot defence; site is very probably live, treat as unverified not dead

candidates.why_relevant: English-language Czech news site (publisher Howlings s.r.o., since 2001) with a 'Business & Money' desk. Verified on fetch: it exists and covers Czech economic and corporate-ownership stories in English (e.g. frozen shares of Russian operators of retail chains) — the main English bridge into CZ mainstream business coverage for non-Czech-reading analysts.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted; open access
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily crawl of /czech-news/economy and /czech-news/daily-news; useful mainly as an English-language cross-check and translation shortcut, not as a primary.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (English-in-local channel) + direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: English-language service of Czech Radio (public broadcaster), historically carrying business/economy briefs on Czech banks and the koruna for an international audience. Fetch returned 403, so section structure is unverified this run.
candidates.legal_status: public broadcaster content, copyrighted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Browser-based pass to map the business/economy section and RSS; low-frequency polling.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (public broadcaster English service) + attempted fetch
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 403 Forbidden on WebFetch — bot defence hypothesis, not a liveness verdict

candidates.source_name: Newton Media / NewtonOne (media monitoring & licensed archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Prague-headquartered media-monitoring group, verified on fetch as covering print, online, social and broadcast across Czechia and CEE with a licensed archive delivered through the NewtonOne platform. This is the legal route to full text of paywalled and print-only CZ coverage (HN, Ekonom, Lidovky, regional Deník titles) and to broadcast mentions — i.e. it solves the collection problem for most of this cell at once.
candidates.legal_status: licensed aggregator — collection via NewtonOne is contractually permitted where the licence covers it; this is the compliant alternative to paywall scraping
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Commercial subscription with standing keyword profiles (bank names, 'zisk', 'čtvrtletní výsledky', 'platební'); export via the platform/API rather than crawling publisher sites.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (who aggregates/archives) + direct fetch (the /cs path 404'd, root resolved)

candidates.why_relevant: Czech media-monitoring service widely used as a lower-cost alternative to Newton/Anopress for keyword monitoring across Czech online, print and broadcast media. Would give a single machine-readable stream over the whole cell. Not verified this run — the fetch failed on a TLS error.
candidates.legal_status: licensed aggregator (assumed); confirm redistribution rights before storing full text
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Evaluate in a browser-based pass; if it offers an API, use standing keyword profiles as with Newton.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (aggregator layer); attempted fetch on both apex and www
queries_used: direct fetch: https://monitora.cz/ (TLS: self signed certificate)
direct fetch: https://www.monitora.cz/ (TLS: self signed certificate)
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch failed with 'self signed certificate' on both apex and www — most likely TLS interception in this fetch environment rather than a broken site; unverified, not dead

candidates.source_name: Anopress IT — Czech full-text media archive
candidates.why_relevant: The long-established Czech full-text media database, used by libraries, universities and corporates for retrospective searches of Czech print and online media back many years. It is the natural tool for reconstructing multi-year narratives around a bank (past results seasons, past deals) that no live crawl can recover. Not verified this run — fetch failed on an expired certificate.
candidates.legal_status: licensed archive; institutional access often available via Czech university/National Library subscriptions
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Institutional or commercial access for targeted retrospective queries; not a continuous feed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (archive layer); attempted fetch
queries_used: direct fetch: https://www.anopress.cz/ (TLS: certificate has expired)
candidates.observed_blocker: WebFetch failed with 'certificate has expired' — could be a genuinely stale certificate or fetch-environment TLS handling; treat as unverified

candidates.why_relevant: Trade title for the Czech media/advertising industry. Verified on fetch that it tracks media ownership, publisher corporate changes, audience/ratings data and personnel moves. For a source-scouting programme this is the meta-source: it tells you who owns HN/E15/iDNES today, which desks are being cut or launched, and which journalists moved where — all of which determines the reliability and continuity of every other source in this cell.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency crawl of /aktuality and /lide, keyword-filtered on the publisher names in this cell (Economia, Czech News Center, MAFRA, Seznam, N Media, VLM).
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (who documents the media system itself) + direct fetch

candidates.why_relevant: Right-leaning news site and Týdeník Echo weekly; contributes commentary on bank windfall taxation, ČNB policy and state-vs-bank disputes. Included for completeness of the mainstream commentary spectrum; the guessed economy section path 404'd so its structure is unverified.
candidates.legal_status: copyrighted
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Map the real section path in a browser pass, then low-frequency keyword-filtered crawl; tag as opinion.
candidates.discovered_via_method: first-principles inference (commentary spectrum); attempted fetch of guessed section path
candidates.observed_blocker: HTTP 404 on the guessed /ekonomika path — indicates a different URL scheme, not a dead site

negative_findings.description: The session's WebSearch budget (200/200 calls) was already exhausted by earlier agents before this scout issued its first query. Both attempted seed queries — 'Hospodářské noviny banka hospodářské výsledky zisk čtvrtletí' (cs) and 'Seznam Zprávy Aktuálně banky výsledky platby analýza' (cs) — were refused by the tool with a budget message, and no further cs or en search-engine queries could be run.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero search-engine results obtained. Discovery was carried out entirely by direct fetching of candidate domains and by snowballing section trees, publisher names and RSS paths out of the fetched navigation of each site.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Search-engine discovery is how you find the outlets you did not already think of — smaller CZ business titles, journalist blogs, newsletter products, tag pages for individual banks. This slice is therefore strong on the named backbone outlets and structurally verified section URLs, but weaker on long-tail discovery than a normal run. A re-run with search budget should be scheduled before this cell is considered complete.

negative_findings.description: Both MAFRA-group domains named in the cell brief — ekonomika.idnes.cz and www.lidovky.cz — were refused by the fetch tool itself with 'Claude Code is unable to fetch from <host>'. This is a client-side domain block, not a server response.
negative_findings.result_summary: No structural verification of iDNES Ekonomika or Lidovky Ekonomika: section paths, RSS feeds and paywall model remain unconfirmed. Both are recorded as candidates with blocked=true and reduced confidence, NOT as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: iDNES is one of the highest-reach Czech news portals and Lidovky is a quality daily; missing their feed structure leaves a hole in mass-reach amplification signal. A browser-based pass (Chrome MCP) or a plain HTTP client outside this tool should recover them cheaply.

negative_findings.description: Four further hosts failed on transport or bot-defence grounds: monitora.cz and www.monitora.cz ('self signed certificate'), www.anopress.cz ('certificate has expired'), www.denik.cz/ekonomika/ (HTTP 403), english.radio.cz (HTTP 403).
negative_findings.result_summary: None of these could be structurally verified. Per the playbook, 403s and TLS failures are treated as bot-defended-or-environment issues, i.e. hypotheses, not liveness verdicts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Two of them (Monitora, Anopress) are aggregator/archive routes that would materially reduce the cost and legal risk of collecting paywalled CZ coverage, so they are worth re-testing rather than dropping.

negative_findings.description: Several guessed section URLs did not resolve: seznamzpravy.cz/sekce/ekonomika-11 returned the World desk rather than economics (correct IDs are ekonomika-194 and ekonomika-finance-299, recovered from the homepage nav); denikn.cz/rubrika/byznys/ 404'd (correct path /ekonomika/ plus tag pages); info.cz/ekonomika 404'd; echo24.cz/ekonomika 404'd; newtonmedia.eu/cs 404'd; forbes.cz/rubrika/byznys/ 301-redirected to a 2014 CDN image file.
negative_findings.result_summary: Section IDs and paths in the Czech mainstream media are not guessable and several are stale; all confirmed paths in this slice were taken from fetched navigation, not assumed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any crawler for this cell must resolve section URLs from live navigation at build time and re-validate them periodically, otherwise feeds will silently go empty after a site relaunch. The Forbes case shows a redirect can point at a legacy asset and still return 301, which naive crawlers will treat as success.

negative_findings.description: Apart from E15's explicit 'Finance a bankovnictví' section, no outlet in this cell was confirmed to expose a standing banking-only landing page. HN uses byznys.hn.cz, Seznam Zprávy uses a general Finance sub-desk, Aktuálně and ČT24 use a general Ekonomika rubric.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank-specific filtering will mostly have to be done downstream by keyword, not by subscribing to a beat feed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Drives collection design: expect a low signal-to-noise ratio on general economy feeds and budget for a Czech-language keyword/entity filter (bank names in all inflected forms plus 'zisk', 'výsledky', 'platební', 'poplatky').

negative_findings.description: The most analytically valuable titles in this cell are the most closed: Ekonom returned a hard subscription wall ('Pro tento web nemáte aktivní předplatné'), HN gates premium behind HN+ and sells print PDFs at 40 Kč per issue, Deník N is freemium-paywalled, E15 has an e15 Premium tier.
negative_findings.result_summary: Free open access in this cell is concentrated in Aktuálně.cz, Seznam Zprávy, Novinky.cz, ČT24, ČeskéNoviny.cz/ČTK, Euro.cz and CzechCrunch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collection plan that relies only on open sources will systematically capture wire copy and consumer-facing amplification while missing the executive comment and unpublished figures that are the stated reason this cell exists. Budget for 3-4 subscription seats or a Newton/Monitora licence.

negative_findings.description: Local-language (cs) working terms were used throughout — byznys, ekonomika, finance a bankovnictví, zisk, hospodářské výsledky, čtvrtletí, tisková zpráva, předplatné, rubrika, sekce, vydání, archiv, monitoring médií, pobočka, bankomat, hotovost, dobírka, úrokové sazby, ČNB — and cs terms in fetched pages were used to confirm section identity. However, because the search tool was unavailable, these terms were applied to site navigation and listing pages rather than to search queries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Local-language verification was achieved at the site level (Czech section names, Czech paywall strings, Czech article headlines read on-page), but not at the query level.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The mandatory local-language requirement is only partially satisfied: cs was used for reading and classification but no cs search query returned results. This must be closed on a re-run.

coverage_gaps.description: No search-engine discovery was possible (WebSearch budget exhausted at 200/200 before this agent ran), so the six seed queries and their planned cs/en extensions were never executed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-run this cell with search budget available, executing at minimum the six seed queries plus cs extensions on individual bank names in inflected form ('Komerční banka zisk', 'Česká spořitelna výsledky', 'ČSOB hospodářské výsledky', 'Moneta Money Bank čtvrtletí', 'Raiffeisenbank ČR zisk', 'Air Bank Partners banka', 'platební brána akvizice') and en extensions ('Czech bank profit Prague newspaper', 'Czech payments deal coverage English').

coverage_gaps.description: Two outlets explicitly named in the cell brief — iDNES Ekonomika and Lidovky — could not be reached at all because the fetch tool blocks the MAFRA hosts. Their RSS paths, section structure and paywall model are unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Verify both via the Chrome browser MCP or a plain HTTP client; specifically capture the ekonomika.idnes.cz RSS/servis feed path and the lidovky.cz ekonomika feed, and record the MAFRA Premium paywall boundary.

coverage_gaps.description: Broadcast and audio were only partially covered. ČT24's economy desk was verified, but Czech Radio's business output (Český rozhlas Plus / Radiožurnál business slots, ČRo's 'Zaostřeno'-style formats) and the fast-growing Czech business-podcast layer (HN podcasts, Seznam Zprávy podcasts, Info.cz's large podcast slate, CzechCrunch audio) were not mapped. Bank CEOs give figures and forward guidance in podcast interviews that appear nowhere in text.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map Český rozhlas business programming and the podcast feeds of HN, Seznam Zprávy, E15 (FLOW) and CzechCrunch; collect episode RSS with titles/descriptions and transcribe episodes featuring named bank or payment-firm executives.

coverage_gaps.description: Newsletter products were not mapped. Czech business newsrooms increasingly put their best analysis in paid newsletters (HN's business newsletters, Ekonom's Wednesday newsletter observed on-site, Deník N's 'Ranních 5 minut', E15 and CzechCrunch mailings) which are not on the public web and are not indexed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate and subscribe to the finance/business newsletters of the outlets in this slice; route them to a dedicated mailbox that the collector can parse.

coverage_gaps.description: No actor map of individual Czech banking/finance journalists was built (bylines, their outlet moves, and their personal X/LinkedIn/Bluesky accounts where scoops often break minutes before the article). MediaGuru was identified as the pointer that would support this but its /lide personnel feed was not mined.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a named-journalist registry for the cell by harvesting bylines from the verified section listings over ~60 days, cross-checked against MediaGuru personnel news; then track their social accounts as an early-warning layer.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language CZ business coverage is thin in this slice: only Expats.cz was verified, Radio Prague International returned 403, and other English titles (Prague Morning, Brno Daily, the English output of Czech agencies) were not reachable without search.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: In a re-run, verify Prague Morning and Brno Daily, and check whether ČTK offers an English wire product; this matters for any downstream consumer who cannot read Czech.

coverage_gaps.description: Specialist finance/investment media that a naive scout would sweep up here — Patria.cz, Kurzy.cz, Investiční web, Roklen24, Měšec.cz, Peníze.cz, Bankovnípoplatky.com — were deliberately NOT claimed by this cell, which is scoped to general business/economic media. They were also not verified, so nothing should be assumed about them from this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Confirm that the specialist-finance-media cell in this run covers these domains; if no such cell exists, raise them for reassignment rather than leaving them uncovered.

coverage_gaps.description: The compliant full-text route for paywalled and print-only CZ coverage is unresolved. Newton Media was verified as offering a licensed CEE archive, but Monitora and Anopress could not be reached, and no pricing, API capability or redistribution terms were established for any of the three.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Request commercial terms from Newton Media (NewtonOne) and Monitora, and check whether Anopress is already available through a Czech university/National Library institutional subscription; compare against the cost of 3-4 direct publisher subscriptions (HN+/Ekonom bundle, E15 Premium, Deník N).

brief: Czech mainstream business media form a compact, highly concentrated landscape dominated by four publishing houses — Economia (Hospodářské noviny, Ekonom, Aktuálně.cz), Czech News Center (E15), MAFRA (iDNES, Lidovky) and Seznam.cz (Seznam Zprávy, Novinky.cz) — sitting on top of one wire, ČTK, whose ČeskéNoviny.cz and Protext PR service timestamp and seed most bank-results coverage before any outlet adds interpretation. Only E15 maintains an explicit banking beat ('Finance a bankovnictví'); everywhere else banking sits inside a general Ekonomika/Byznys rubric, so downstream Czech-language keyword and entity filtering is unavoidable. The analytically richest material — executive comment, deal detail, unpublished figures — is concentrated behind paywalls (Ekonom hard-walled, HN+, Deník N, e15 Premium) and in print, which makes a licensed aggregator (Newton Media/NewtonOne, possibly Monitora or Anopress) or a small set of publisher subscriptions a prerequisite rather than an optimisation; free, RSS-friendly coverage from Aktuálně.cz, Seznam Zprávy, ČT24 and ČTK gives good breadth and speed but mostly wire-level depth. This slice was built entirely by direct fetching and navigation snowballing because the session's search budget was exhausted before it started, so section URLs here are structurally verified but long-tail discovery, the journalist/newsletter/podcast layers, and the two blocked MAFRA titles remain open and should be closed on a re-run.
